explanation: Cancel unequal entries against a current candidate and reset the candidate when its counter reaches zero. Under the guaranteed-majority contract, the remaining candidate must be the majority value.
timeComplexity: O(n) comparisons, with string-comparison costs depending on word lengths.
spaceComplexity: O(L) space for the copied candidate and current word, with maximum word length L.
